chunks: Because the Commander of the Faithful, عليه السلام, said:
"That I break my fast for one day of the month of Ramadan is more beloved to me than that I fast one day from Sha'ban and add it into the month of Ramadan."

key_terms.أَزِيدُهُ: to add it, meaning to count an extra day as part of Ramadan
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, عليه السلام
key_terms.أُفْطِرَ: to break the fast or not observe the fast
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the obligatory month of fasting

ai.seo_question: Why is it better not to add a doubtful day of Sha'ban to Ramadan in fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes caution in defining the limits of the month of Ramadan and discourages adding a doubtful day from Sha'ban into it. It reflects a legal principle in fasting rulings: it is preferable not to treat an uncertain day as part of Ramadan without certainty.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1923 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), said:
"Breaking my fast on one day in the Month of Ramadan is more beloved to me than fasting one day from Sha'ban and adding it to the Month of Ramadan."
